record.paper_title: Billiard dynamics: A survey with the emphasis on open problems
record.original_question: Let P be an n-gon, let Φ be the phase space of its billiard map, and let Φ_i be the subset of phase points whose footpoint lies on side a_i. If M⊂Φ is a measurable invariant subset and Φ_i⊂M for some i, must M equal all of Φ?

evidence.quote: Задача/Гипотеза 9. Пусть P — произвольный n-угольник, и пусть M ⊂ Φ — измеримое инвариантное подмножество. Если Φi ⊂ M для некоторого 1 ≤ i ≤ n, то M = Φ.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P$ be a (not necessarily rational) simple polygon in the plane with $n$ sides $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$. Consider the billiard dynamics on $P$: a point particle moves with unit speed along straight lines inside $P$ and reflects off the boundary by the law of equal angles (orbits hitting a vertex are left undefined). Let $\Phi$ denote the phase space of the billiard map, namely the set of unit tangent vectors $(x, v)$ with $x$ on the boundary $\partial P$ pointing into $P$, and let $T : \Phi \to \Phi$ be the billiard map (defined almost everywhere). For each $i \in \{1, \ldots, n\}$, let
\[ \Phi_i = \{(x, v) \in \Phi : x \in a_i\} \]
denote the set of phase points whose footpoint lies on side $a_i$. Equip $\Phi$ with its natural invariant Lebesgue (Liouville) measure.

Suppose $M \subset \Phi$ is a measurable $T$-invariant subset, and suppose there exists some index $i \in \{1, \ldots, n\}$ such that $\Phi_i \subset M$. Must it follow that $M = \Phi$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem/conjecture in surveys on polygonal billiard dynamics. Searches turn up related open problems on invariant sets and ergodicity of polygonal billiards (e.g. weakly mixing polygonal billiards, ergodicity in rational polygons), but no resolution of this specific statement that an invariant measurable set containing the fiber over one side must be all of phase space. No published proof or counterexample was located.

status_evidence.title: Rational billiards and flat structures (Masur–Tabachnikov handbook)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of rational and irrational polygonal billiards listing open ergodic-theoretic problems regarding invariant sets in the phase space.
status_evidence.claim: Standard survey of polygonal billiard dynamics that frames the type of invariant-set questions of which this problem is a representative open conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Weakly Mixing Polygonal Billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on ergodic and mixing properties of polygonal billiards; questions about structure of invariant measurable sets remain largely open.
status_evidence.claim: Demonstrates that fine structure of invariant sets in polygonal billiards is an active area, with the present problem not appearing among the resolved cases.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
status_evidence.snippet: Recent open-problems compilation in billiards; problems about invariant subsets in polygonal billiards continue to be listed as open.
status_evidence.claim: Supports that questions of this form remain open in the current literature.
